subtasks.description: Declare four 32-bit registers (r0, r1, r2, r3) to hold the current 128-bit round key. These registers are the central storage used by output assignment and key expansion logic.
constraints: All four registers must be 32-bit and update only on clock rising edge.

subtasks.description: Instantiate a single aes_rcon module to generate 32-bit round constants. Connect clk and kld directly from module inputs, and route its out port to internal signal rcon_out.
constraints: Exactly one aes_rcon instance with port map: .clk(clk), .kld(kld), .out(rcon_out).

subtasks.description: Instantiate four aes_sbox modules to perform SubWord on the rotated bytes. Connect each instance's input port a to a distinct byte of the post-RotWord value, and collect their outputs on b ports to form the SubWord result.
constraints: Exactly four aes_sbox instances; each instance processes one 8-bit input byte and produces one 8-bit output byte.

subtasks.description: Combinational logic to compute next-round words. Apply RotWord to r3 (cyclic left byte shift), route each rotated byte to an aes_sbox input, combine sbox outputs to form SubWord, XOR with rcon_out to get T, then compute nxt_r0 = r0 XOR T; nxt_r1 = r1 XOR nxt_r0 XOR T; nxt_r2 = r2 XOR nxt_r0 XOR nxt_r1 XOR T; nxt_r3 = r3 XOR nxt_r0 XOR nxt_r1 XOR nxt_r2 XOR T.
constraints: RotWord must be cyclic left shift of bytes: [a0,a1,a2,a3] → [a1,a2,a3,a0].
The multi-XOR equations for nxt_r1..nxt_r3 must follow the cumulative XOR pattern described in S008.

subtasks.description: On rising clock edge, if kld is high, load r0 from key[127:96], r1 from key[95:64], r2 from key[63:32], r3 from key[31:0]; otherwise load r0 from nxt_r0, r1 from nxt_r1, r2 from nxt_r2, r3 from nxt_r3. This block is the sole updater of the round-key registers.
constraints: All register updates are synchronous to clk rising edge; no asynchronous resets or loads.

subtasks.description: Continuous combinational assignments: assign wo_0 = r0, wo_1 = r1, wo_2 = r2, wo_3 = r3. Outputs follow the register values without any delay.
